beats.say: Three astronauts are trapped in a sinking capsule in Above the Below.
The upcoming British American survival thriller film is co directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen.
Elba stars alongside Caitlin FitzGerald and Hero Fiennes Tiffin.
Elizabeth Morris, Matt Mitchell, and Vicki Sargent wrote the screenplay from a story by Owen.
The film is scheduled to be released on 4 December 2026.
Will you be watching Above the Below in cinemas?
